title: Computing the relative Brauer group of a genus 1 curve
literal_statement:
Let $k$ be a field and let $C/k$ be a genus $1$ curve. How can one compute the relative Brauer group
\[
\operatorname{Br}(C/k)=\ker\!\bigl(\operatorname{Br}(k)\to\operatorname{Br}(k(C))\bigr)?
\]
scope_and_reason: The base field is arbitrary. Hochschild-Serre evaluation identifies an obstruction map from rational Picard classes to Br(k), but computing its image requires effective field and torsor data; this is not a uniform terminating algorithm for arbitrary k.

title: Full Γ-limit for a singularly perturbed Eikonal functional
literal_statement:
Determine the full $\Gamma$-limit of the functionals
$$
F_\varepsilon[u,\Omega]=\int_\Omega\left\{\frac{(1-|\nabla u(x)|^2)^2}{\varepsilon}+\varepsilon|D^2u(x)|^2\right\}\,dx,

scope_and_reason: Removing BV covers singular eikonal limits beyond rectifiable jump sets. BV recovery sequences and jump-energy lower bounds do not extend automatically to gradients without bounded variation; all admissible limits require compactness and matching liminf/limsup.
